record.bible_text: Then Job<WH0347> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>,

<FI> Then<Fi> would I speak<WH01696><WTH8762>, and not fear<WH03372><WTH8799> him; but <FI>it is<Fi> not so with me. <RF>it is...: Heb. I am not so with myself<Rf><CM>
